title: Plays by device
statementMd:
Count plays per device.

Expected columns: `device`, `plays`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT device, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM plays GROUP BY device;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
